narration.en: The 8085 understands a vocabulary of 74 instructions, written as short mnemonics like MOV, ADD and JMP. Every program, however clever, is built from these words.
narration.kn: 8085 MOV, ADD, JMP ಮುಂತಾದ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಸ್ಮರಣಾಕ್ಷರಗಳ (ನೆಮೋನಿಕ್) 74 ಸೂಚನೆಗಳ ಶಬ್ದಕೋಶವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಈ ಪದಗಳಿಂದಲೇ ರಚನೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: An instruction has an opcode (what to do) and an operand (on what). By size, 8085 instructions are 1-byte (opcode only, e.g. MOV A, B; ADD B), 2-byte (opcode + 8-bit data or port address, e.g. MVI A, 32H; IN 01H) or 3-byte (opcode + 16-bit address or data stored low byte first, e.g. LDA 2050H; JMP 2000H; LXI H, 2050H). By function there are five groups: data transfer (MOV, MVI, LDA, STA, LXI, IN, OUT), arithmetic (ADD, ADI, SUB, INR, DCR, INX), logical (ANA, ORA, XRA, CMA, CMP, RLC), branching (JMP, JZ, JNZ, JC, CALL, RET) and machine control (HLT, NOP, EI, DI).

points.en: 16-bit operands are stored low byte first
Groups: data transfer, arithmetic, logical, branching, machine control

narration.en: An instruction is an opcode plus an operand, one, two or three bytes long. By function they fall into five groups: data transfer, arithmetic, logical, branching and machine control.

explanation.en: Immediate: the data are in the instruction. Register: the operand is in a register. Direct: the instruction gives the memory or port address. Register indirect: a register pair (HL for M, or BC) holds the address.

body.en: The addressing mode is the way an instruction specifies its operand. Immediate: the data are in the instruction (MVI B, 45H; ADI 05H). Register: the operand is in a register (MOV A, B; ADD C). Direct: the instruction gives the 16-bit memory address (LDA 2050H; STA 3000H). Register indirect: a register pair holds the memory address (MOV A, M uses HL; LDAX B uses BC). Implied (implicit): the operand is understood, usually the accumulator (CMA, RLC, STC).

narration.en: There are five addressing modes: immediate, register, direct, register indirect and implied. In register indirect, the H L pair points to the memory location M.
